name: Unspecified Reboot Monkey-supported data center lead, Puerto San José
notes: Weak lead only: LinkedIn job posting places a Data Center Technician role in Puerto San José, Escuintla and describes support for on-demand/global data-center operations; no public facility name, owner, capacity, or project announcement found.

name: Aurum Equity / Bold Capital / Innovative Strategies 50MW Guatemala City data center
developer: Aurum Equity Partners; Bold Capital Group; Innovative Strategies
notes: DCD reported US$300m financing and a 50MW Guatemala City facility expected around mid-2026; current directory data also lists Aurum Equity: Guatemala City but marks it in doubt/under construction, so status is kept unknown pending a primary update.

name: IFX Networks Orión Data Center
developer: IFX Networks / Emerging Networks Guatemala S.A.
notes: Operational Mixco campus in the Guatemala City metro; DCD reports more than US$25m investment and nearly 5,000 sq m of technological infrastructure. Uptime Institute lists Datacenter Orión in Ciudad de Guatemala with Tier III design and constructed-facility certification.

name: KIO Guatemala GTM2
notes: Second KIO Guatemala facility in Condado Naranjo, Mixco, beside GTM1/Campus TEC; investment over US$20m, initial 1MW, racks designed for 8-12kW, service expected Q1 2027.

name: KIO Guatemala GTM1
notes: Existing KIO facility in Condado Naranjo/Mixco; Prensa Libre reports GTM1 has 385kW installed capacity and has operated in Guatemala for about 13 years.

name: Navégalo Guatemala Data Center
notes: Carrier-neutral Guatemala City/Mixco-area data center; Navégalo's official location page describes certified infrastructure, cloud/server/connectivity services and 24/7/365 NOC/SOC support. Baxtel lists it as the largest Guatemala City facility at 1MW and 26,910 sq ft.

name: Claro Guatemala Data Center El Zapote
developer: Claro Empresas / Telecomunicaciones de Guatemala S.A. / América Móvil
notes: Claro's official page reports ICREA Red Seal Level IV certification, 99.99% availability design, and support for up to 90 certified racks at up to 7kW per rack; Guatemala.com identifies the center as Claro El Zapote.

name: Tigo DC Fraijanes / Fraijanes II
notes: New Tigo Business data center in Fraijanes, Guatemala department; reported investment about US$7.5m, 99.99% availability, modular/scalable infrastructure, and Uptime Tier III design certification for Fraijanes II.

name: Tigo DC Guatemala
notes: Existing Tigo Guatemala data center at 46 Calle 24-50, Guatemala department; DataCenterMap lists 1.5MW, and DCD reported the Guatemala center received a security operations center update in 2019.

name: LOQUI Guatemala Data Center
developer: LOQUI Guatemala; Huawei Digital Power Latinoamérica
notes: Zona 13 / Guatemala City colocation data center that began operation in June 2022. DCD reports Phase 1 at 60kW and Phase 2 at 285kW, with first two phases operational and a third phase in final design.

name: Ministerio de Cultura y Deportes Modular Data Center
developer: Ministerio de Cultura y Deportes de Guatemala
notes: Government modular data center received by the Ministry on 2026-03-26 to support hybrid infrastructure, institutional systems, information storage, backup, and 24/7 availability.

name: GBM Data Center Zona Pradera, Fase 1
notes: Uptime Institute lists Data Center Zona Pradera, Fase 1 in Ciudad de Guatemala with Tier III design and constructed-facility certifications for GBM de Guatemala S.A.

name: IPXON Guatemala / GUA1
notes: Guatemala City POP/data-center services location at Edificio 74, Zona 9; DataCenterMap lists 25 sq m built-out whitespace, est. 2022, N+1 UPS/cooling/standby power, and Tier Design 3.

name: Data Center Guatemala / Datacenter Guatemala
notes: Guatemala City colocation/hosting facility at 6 Av. y 10 Calle Zona 1, Plaza Vivar; DataCenterMap says it has offered domain, hosting, VPS, dedicated server, colocation, backup, and cloud services since 1997.

name: Banco Promerica Guatemala Data Center retrofit / relocation
notes: Enterprise/private bank data-center modernization and relocation into Torre Céntrica; Electrotécnica case study says the former bank data-center space was transformed into a modernized center during the pandemic-era project.
